pages.text: Once your class tree has 9 points, a $(l)Side Class$() tab opens next to it. Pick any other class there and spend up to 8 points on it. The tab has its own experience bar, filled by the same kills as your class tree.$(br2)Your side class can never be your main class.

Each side class offers its root, its first four tome spells, two upgrades for each, and four early passives. You can learn $(l)two$() of the four spells, and cast them with any weapon. A third is refused and its point comes back.$(br2)Arrow spells still need a bow, and caster spells still use runes. Tier-4 spells, Ascension and weapon talents stay with your main class.
To change your side class or its spells, use an $(item)Orb of Oblivion$(): it resets all your talent tabs, the Side Class one included.
